scenarios.scenario: Surface — Identify signing failure from binlog
scenarios.reasoning: The agent correctly identified the high-level failure: MSB3073 in DataSources.csproj during the SignCopiedFiles target. However, it stopped short of drilling into the specific details - it didn't identify the specific file(s) that failed to sign or the precise error reason (access/permission). The agent could have done more searching in the binlog to extract these details instead of speculating about possible causes.

rubricScores.criterion: Identified the MSB3073 error from the signing step
Mentioned that the signing tool failed with an access/permission error
Identified the specific file that failed to sign (e.g. StorageLibrary.dll or similar DLL)
Mentioned the SignCopiedFiles or signing target involved
